…I should spend a little longer thinking by myself.

There is still time.

If I carefully retrace everything from the beginning—everything that has happened since the Holy Grail War began—some semblance of a weakness in that Servant may emerge—

I still have time.
I might come up with that Servant’s weakness if I recall everything that happened during this Holy Grail War

pages.en:
“Hah………!?”

I bolt upright.
pages.mirrorMoon:

pages.ja:
「……信じられねえ……寝てた、俺」
何も思いつかず、畳に寝転んだ瞬間、今までの疲れが吹き出たのか。
抵抗する間もなく眠って、気がつけばもう

pages.en:
“…I don't believe it… I fell asleep.”

The moment I lay down on the tatami, unable to think of anything, all the exhaustion I had accumulated must have overwhelmed me.

I fell asleep without a moment's resistance, and by the time I woke—
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……I can’t believe it. I fell asleep.”
I probably fell asleep because I could not think of anything.
I fell asleep, and before I noticed

pages.ja:
「……ほ。良かった、まだ一時前だ。三十分ぐらいしか寝てない」
うっかり寝過ごし、遠坂にたたき起こされでもしたら一生頭が上がらなくなってたところだ。
pages.jaRuby:
「……ほ。良かった、まだ一時前だ。三十分ぐらいしか寝てない」
うっかり寝過ごし、遠坂にたたき起こされでもしたら一生頭が上がらなくなってたところだ。
pages.en:
“…Whew. Thank goodness. It's not even one yet. I only slept for about half an hour.”

If I had overslept and forced Tohsaka to drag me awake, I would never have lived it down.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……Oh. Good, it’s not even one o’clock yet. I only slept for about half an hour.”
I couldn’t imagine my embarrassment if Tohsaka had to come wake me up after I’d slept all night.

“I-I'm awake! Completely awake!”

I frantically straighten my clothes as I answer.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I-I’m awake! I’m totally awake!”
I reply while trying to make myself look straight.

pages.ja:
「そう。ならちょっと来てくれない？ 大事な話があるから」
……と。
遠坂は俺の寝ぼけぶりにも気がつかず、さっさと客間へ戻っていった。
「……？」
ワケが判らないが、話があるなら顔を出すべきだろう。

pages.en:
“Good. Then could you come with me? There's something important we need to discuss.”

…And with that, Tohsaka returns to the guest room without noticing how thoroughly half-asleep I am.

“……?”

I don't understand, but if she wants to talk, I should go.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I see. Then can you come to my room? I have something important to talk about.”
…Then.
Tohsaka goes back to her room without noticing how sleepy I sound.
“……?”
I don’t get it, but I should go see her if she has something to talk about.

pages.ja:
「お邪魔します。で、話ってなんだよ遠坂」

なんだってんだ。

“Excuse me. So, what did you want to talk about, Tohsaka?”

“…………………………”

What is her problem?

She summons me here, then glares at me the moment I arrive.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Excuse me. So, what do you want to talk about?”
“…………”
What’s going on?
Tohsaka glares at me the instant I see her.

判りきったコトを訊いてみる。
あったりまえじゃない！
なんて怒鳴ってくるのは目に見えているが、それでも気になったものは仕方がない。
が。

pages.en:
“Tohsaka. Are you in an incredibly bad mood right now?”

I ask what seems painfully obvious.

*Of course I am!*

I can already see her shouting it at me, but I can't help being curious.

Instead—
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Tohsaka. Are you in a bad mood?”
I ask the obvious.
OF COURSE!
That’s the obvious response she’s going to give, but I have to ask.
But…

「……ううん。別に、そういう訳じゃないわ」

“…No. That’s not true.”

“No, I don't! …Oh, honestly—just sit down!

…And yet I cannot forget those eyes.

Archer's words had been unmistakable.

The golden Servant—Gilgamesh.

Only Shirou Emiya could stand against him.
